body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #1, company drawn at random (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.35 (naive base rate 0.50) that: Environment Clearance for Sunflag's Bajna iron-ore block (Chhatarpur, MP) is granted on or before 30-Sep-2027. Our reasoning: hand ledger of 5 mine-status statements FY24-FY26: 0 reached production on any stated pace; Lohardongri reversed after 7 years; Bajna was already 'pending' in FY25. Naive base: management's own AR26 statement ('EC and Stage I clearances are likely to be in place during the end of Sep-2026') taken with one year of slack = coin flip. Resolution: YES if a Sunflag filing (Reg-30, quarterly results notes, or the FY2026-27 Annual Report mine-status table) or the MoEF&CC Parivesh record shows the Environment Clearance for the Bajna iron-ore block granted on or before 30-Sep-2027. NO otherwise (including 'listed/pending' language in the FY27 AR). Source: NSE announcements + FY2026-27 Annual Report (board's report, 'Present Status of Coal and Mineral Mines') + parivesh.nic.in. Resolve by 2027-09-30; score with Brier vs the base rate to test whether deep-dive probabilities beat naive base rates.
